title: FCC Invoice
description: Federal Communications Commission (FCC) political advertising invoice showing broadcast time purchases, including line items with descriptions, dates, rates, and totals for political advertising campaigns.

agency.description: The advertising agency or media buyer handling the political advertising purchase.

advertiser.description: The political advertiser or campaign purchasing the broadcast time.

gross_total.description: The total gross amount for all line items before any discounts or adjustments.

net_amount_due.description: The final net amount due after any discounts or adjustments have been applied.

line_item__description.description: Each line item description is usually a specification in industry short-hand of when the advertisement should run. Examples include "M-F 6p-6:30p", "M-F 11a-12p"

line_item__days.description: Each list item will be a string with shorthand representing the days of the week the ad should run. I.e. "MTWTF--"

line_item__rate.description: Each entry is a unitless float, i.e. "300.00", or "1200.00"

line_item__start_date.description: Each start date, formatted as MM/DD/YY. i.e. "11/07/21"

line_item__end_date.description: Each end date, formatted as MM/DD/YY. i.e. "11/07/21"
